title: Shrink!
description: this datapack adds 3 items that let you shrink down!
body:
Textures by the [Chiseled Me](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chiseled-me) mod on curse forge :D

To make the datapack function properly install also the texture pack.

You can give yourself the items with /function command or in crafting table using a diamond
and lapis/redstone/iron

I created this datapack cuz the original mod by [ necauqua](https://www.curseforge.com/members/necauqua/projects) has been discontinued :(

Look for the gallery to see its contents and how they look!

No one downloads datapacks anymore D:
